entries.product: EDGAR submissions, filings, and Company Facts/XBRL APIs
entries.point_in_time_policy: Use filing acceptance/known availability; never use report period end as publication time.
entries.revision_policy: Preserve filing accession and amendments as separate dated evidence.
entries.series_selection: Existing SEC ingestion and normalized facts
limitations: XBRL coverage varies by filer and tag.

entries.product: Petroleum spot-price time series via EIA Open Data API
entries.point_in_time_policy: Use the source publication/release time where documented; otherwise use the archived acquisition timestamp as a conservative availability bound.
entries.revision_policy: Archive each API response with query, acquisition time, and hash; do not backfill later revisions into earlier report snapshots.
entries.series_selection: Select crude benchmarks and relevant refined-product prices by explicit EIA route/series ID before use; do not choose series dynamically from ticker alone.
limitations: Commodity benchmarks are sector context, not company realized prices or margins.
Business mix and hedging can make benchmark movements a poor proxy for issuer exposure.
Industry-specific commodity context only; general macroeconomic indicators are out of scope for this engine.

entries.point_in_time_policy: Include auditor/engagement-participant information only from Form AP records public by report cutoff.
entries.revision_policy: Preserve filing and amendment identifiers where available; archive source download and hash.
entries.series_selection: Auditor identity and reported audit participants only.
limitations: Auditor identity or partner changes are not an audit-quality score.
Interpret only alongside audit opinions, inspection findings, and company disclosures.

entries.product: FDIC BankFind Suite bank and institution data
entries.point_in_time_policy: Match insured institution identity carefully and use only data released by report cutoff.
entries.revision_policy: Archive query, response, release date, and hash; preserve later corrections separately.
entries.series_selection: Only add after mapping the public issuer to regulated bank subsidiaries and selecting exact fields.
limitations: Consolidated public-company results and insured-bank subsidiary results may differ.
Do not apply to non-bank issuers.

entries.publisher: U.S. General Services Administration / participating agencies
entries.point_in_time_policy: Do not ingest from the catalog as a source of record; follow each dataset to its originating agency and document that agency's release policy.
entries.revision_policy: Dataset-specific; must be resolved at source onboarding.
limitations: Catalog listing does not guarantee original-source status, completeness, update cadence, or historical vintages.

scope_note: This stock engine excludes macroeconomic indicator series; TMF Predictive Analytics owns rate and macro analysis. Issuer-specific filings, governance records, bank-specific data, and narrowly mapped industry commodity context may remain.
